cohort: Finnish women born in 1965-1980 diagnosed with schizophrenia, compared with five age- and place-of-birth-matched controls.
finding: Schizophrenia was associated with an increased risk of induction of labor, cesarean section, elective cesarean section, premature birth, low Apgar score at 1 minute, resuscitation, and neonatal monitoring.
mod_finding: Schizophrenia was associated with an increased risk of induction of labor, cesarean section, and elective cesarean section.
